Free, fair and secure elections are the bedrock of our republic. However, Democrat-led states across the country have failed to enact common-sense election integrity measures to combat fraud and cheating. 

After millions of illegal aliens invaded our country during the Biden years, Americans want to know that only U.S. citizens are voting in our elections. I’m pleased to join Senator @MarshaBlackburn in introducing this legislation to strengthen the integrity of and confidence in our elections.

On this 82nd anniversary of D-Day, we pause to remember this pivotal moment in World War II when U.S. and Allied troops set forth on their campaign that liberated Europe from the hands of Nazi Germany. 
 
As we approach America’s 250th birthday, it’s vital that we remember moments in our history like D-Day. Without those who stepped forward and valiantly defended our nation in times of conflict, we would not have the many freedoms and the level of security that we enjoy today.
